mainpictures3.title2: I am proud to invite you

studioGdynia.2679: Small spaces often significant challenges. It was no different from the project of a small studio for my client. The apartment is located in an old tenement house. Originally it consisted of a bathroom, kitchen and living room. Our task was,above all, to separate a sleeping zone and arrange the space so that it would be functional, comfortable and beautiful.
studioGdynia.3681: the small bedroom has been separated from the living room, with windows facing north. The new bedroom has no windows, so we have proposed a folded glass wall instead of the TRADITIONAL wall, which ideally illuminates the room and can be folded if necessary, thus opening the space. The bedroom has a double bed, a bedside table and a wardrobe. The wall is decorated with a beautiful Boudoir Navy WallArt wallpaper that goes all the way to the living room
studioGdynia.3683: in the living room, we have replaced the traditional window with a wallet window, illuminating the interior. The old wardrobe has found use as a bookcase. While the armchair from the 1960s inherited from grandparents fits perfectly into the style of the apartment. The bright sofa looks beautiful against the Boiduar navy wallpaper, and wooden accessories give the interior cosiness.
studioGdynia.3685: the kitchen is elegant and straightforward. Bright colours with wood and the green motif on the walls repeated throughout the apartment. Hanging cabinets are glazed, which gives the kitchen light and elegant touch.

houseEidsberg.2260: Private house for a family of three
houseEidsberg.2321: I present the project of the total metamorphosis of the house from the 1970s. The owners are a young couple with a small child.
houseEidsberg.2918: a large area of ​​the living room is divided into a seating area and a dining room. The interior of the living room and dining room is modern. Still, the décor refers to nature: wallpaper with a motif of leaves, wooden floor and furniture, old brick by the wall with a fireplace, leather sofas - make that the interior is cosy and very comfortable - perfect for a young family.
houseEidsberg.3405: this realization of the project shows how a small renovation can cause massive changes. It has become an ideal place to rest and relax from an unsightly and uncomfortable room. This project is a perfect example of HOME STAGING - a small renovation and adding decorations make the bedroom it has become cosy elegant and at the same time increase the value of the property.
houseEidsberg.3406: a small toilet and a dark colour on the walls? Why not? Here I present a project of a small toilet that has completely changed although it is tiny. I used OSB 3D boards on the walls. These white panels visually expand the area. Dark walls and ceilings make the room seem higher than it is.

salonGlm.3210: The owners of the apartment are a unique family whose favorite style is a modern style with glamorous elements. The living room underwent a significant transformation: on 24 square meters, a comfortable seating area and dining room were created. Although the interior is not large, it has become a place of relaxation and rest, but also fulfills the practical role of a living room with a dining area.

lazMoss.2551: Bathroom in a warm, pleasant composition
lazMoss.3210: A new, spacious bathroom was a big dream for a young family of three. By combining two non-functional rooms, a very spacious bathroom was created that combines natural elements with minimalistic elegance. The built-in cabinet not only hides household appliances, but also provides ample storage space. A comfortable bathtub with a shower is the perfect compromise for those who choose between relaxation and saving time. The dark color of the wall, wallpaper with a plant motif, and a beautiful mirror made from a piece of wood add warmth and a natural look.

domDrammen.2613: Large space and many possibilities. I present a house project with separate zones for the kitchen, living room and dining room.
domDrammen.3210: is the heart of the home. Most of the day is stay here and meals are prepared here - a place that should be unique but also ergonomic and practical. There was a small, impractical room in the designed kitchen area. After demolishing the walls and opening the space, we have a fabulous kitchen with custom-made furniture, a built-in refrigerator and an oven. Two pull-out cargo wardrobes are a perfect place for storage and the multitude of cabinets and drawers will satisfy the most demanding housewife. I combined the beautiful sea colour of the fronts with a marble top and golden accessories. The black lighting, kitchen hood, and wooden accessories constitute a comositional whole. The kitchen is comfortable and beautiful at the same time
domDrammen.3697: were an essential element of interior design for my clients, so I decided to use a vertical garden in a coffee zone separated from the living room. The vertical garden is a unique element, referring to nature and cleverly placing an extensive collection of plants in one place.There is also a 3-seater honey sofa in the coffee area, two comfortable armchairs, and a table. Next to the coffee corner, there is another space:
domDrammen.3698: A bright, comfortable couch with a chaise longue, a comfortable armchair and a table - this is almost everything you need in a TV corner. I placed the TV on a wall covered with old recycled wood planks. Here also a reference to nature, but not only wooden cladding on the wall is also a way to mask the lighting and cables needed to connect the RTV equipment. The whole is complemented by accessories and fabrics that make the interior cosier and elegant.

flatGorlice.2260: An apartment for a young married couple
flatGorlice.2317: Can an attic apartment become a dream enclave for two? Of course! I present the project of an apartment in the attic
flatGorlice.2914: The project included a small apartment in the attic of a tenement house. From an old, non-functional apartment, I have created a beautiful, comfortable, ergonomic interior perfect for young people. Open spaces, natural colours and materials give the interior cosiness and lightness.
flatGorlice.3401: The apartment gained the necessary space by demolishing the walls. Covering the fireplace with stone gave it a new life, and the interior gave character and cosiness. Wooden furniture and accessories and subdued colours refer to the nature and colours of the earth.
flatGorlice.3402: The lower cabinets are mainly drawers due to the lack of hanging cabinets. It is also an excellent solution for an ergonomic space. Dark green tiles bring colour to the interior and blend in beautifully with the cabinets and the tabletop.In the kitchen, I have also designated a small dining room.

salonSandvika.2256: A livingroom for a couple of travellers
salonSandvika.2313: The owners of the apartment are a young couple who are passionate about travelling. Where you go back is also essential in long expeditions. In this case, a comfortable and warm living room with a large, comfortable sofa, a bookcase for an extensive collection of books, a sideboard and a comfortable armchair for the host of the house. Despite the dark colours used, the living room is cosy, the interior is consistent and comfortable, and the decorations emphasize the owners' character.

About.1796: Individuals who have had no previous experience with interior designers tend to associate this profession mainly with fashion and prestige. However, through proper interior design, we can create a pleasant and comfortable environment that positively affects our mood and emotions. The proper arrangement of furniture, choice of colors, and lighting can impact the atmosphere in a room and make us feel more relaxed and satisfied. Therefore, changes in our interiors can be one of the factors that influence our well-being and should be taken into account as they can be an element of improving the quality of life.
